question.question: When a non-Vagabond base faction crafts an item, where does that item come from and where is it placed, and what is the usual VP reward?

expected.expected_answer: Take the corresponding item from the item supply on the map and put it in the Crafted Items box on the faction board. Normally score the card's printed victory points; the Eyrie's Disdain for Trade is the already-tested exception, and Builder suppresses it. Resolve the immediate effect and discard the crafting card.

source_passages.section: Actions — Craft — immediate effect and item token
source_passages.quotation: - Immediate effect (paper box): resolve, then discard the **crafting card**. An item card requires the corresponding **item token** in the map supply, or it cannot be crafted. Take the item token into Crafted Items and score the VP printed on the card, subject to Eyrie exception. The item token stays; the crafting card is discarded. Ordinary factions do not exhaust crafted items as Vagabond does.

source_passages.section: Actions — Craft — separate components after a craft
source_passages.quotation: | Item token produced by an item card | Map item supply | Crafting faction’s Crafted Items box; when Vagabond itself crafts, it may immediately take its crafted item face up into Satchel/track |

answer.ruling: A non-Vagabond faction takes the item token from the map item supply and places it in its Crafted Items box.

answer.ruling: Score the VP printed on the crafting card, subject to the Eyrie exception: Eyrie scores only one VP for a crafted item instead of the printed value, unless Builder ignores Disdain for Trade.
